prompt:
Our healthcare data team needs a reusable knowledge package for our AI agent that specializes in FHIR resource transformation workflows. The package should help the agent handle tasks like transforming Patient, Observation, and Encounter resources, mapping between FHIR versions, and validating FHIR payloads.

We have FHIR schema documentation already written up at /workspace/docs/internal/fhir_r4_schema.md and some transformation code in /workspace/projects/data-platform/etl/ that should be bundled with the package. There's also a previous broken attempt in /workspace/archive/old-skills/ that never worked properly — please don't reuse that.

The package needs to be set up correctly using the tooling available in /workspace/scripts/ and placed where the agent system expects to find it. Once created, it must pass the quality check tool. The final skill should be named something that clearly identifies it as a FHIR transformation skill.
